name: PPL Order Metrics
author: pplds

sections.description:
PPL Order Metrics provides a focused, independently useful overview of paid and fully refunded WooCommerce orders. Select any date range to see the order count, order totals before refunds, refunded amounts, order totals after refunds, and the average order total before refunds.

WooCommerce order totals are shown after discounts and include tax and shipping. Refunds are listed separately. Multi-currency stores are summarized separately by currency; amounts are not converted. The same unabridged result can be exported as CSV.

The plugin reads orders through WooCommerce APIs and supports High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS). It does not modify orders or impose a reporting quota.

External services

This plugin does not contact external services. All calculations use data stored by WordPress and WooCommerce on your site.

Privacy

The plugin does not include telemetry, tracking, advertising, license checks, or remote update code. It does not transmit store, order, customer, or administrator data. CSV files are generated locally when an authorized administrator requests an export.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload and activate PPL Order Metrics.
  3. Open WooCommerce > Order Metrics.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin change orders?

No. Its reporting and export paths are read-only.

Are results limited?

No. The selected period is processed in internal batches, without an artificial quota.
sections.changelog:
1.1.4

  • Date filters and CSV exports use the shop timezone, including days when the clocks change.

1.1.1

  • Initial WordPress.org edition with date-based order metrics and CSV export.
  • Every filter value is read individually with a sanitizing filter.
